# Verizon

> Verizon is a leading telecommunications provider offering wireless plans, home internet (Fios and 5G), TV services, and enterprise solutions with coverage maps, device shopping, and comprehensive support.

Verizon serves both consumer and business customers with integrated wireless, broadband, and entertainment services. The site includes product catalogs, service plans with price-lock guarantees, device financing options, and accessibility resources compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

## Key Topics

- 5G and 5G Ultra Wideband
- myPlan unlimited wireless plans
- Fios home internet
- iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
- Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
- Google Pixel 10 Pro
- Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
- Home internet and broadband
- Device financing and trade-in offers
- Wireless coverage maps
- Enterprise and business solutions
- Bundle deals
- Mobile payment plans
- WCAG accessibility compliance
- Spanish-language services
